_about: Labelled test set. Section ids refer to corpus documents (AR, EE, HH, FS, SF, LM). See corpus/CONTRADICTIONS.md for the planted conflicts.

answerable.question: What is the minimum attendance required to appear for the end-semester examination?
How are marks split between internal assessment and the end-semester exam for a theory course?
What is the minimum I need to score to pass a course?
answerable.expected_answer: 30 per cent in the end-semester exam and 40 per cent overall

answerable.question: What letter grade do I get for 85 marks?
How many days do I have to apply for re-evaluation after results are declared?
What happens if I miss an end-semester exam because I was ill?
answerable.expected_answer: medical certificate within 5 working days; appear in the next supplementary as a first attempt without fee

answerable.question: What is the penalty if I am caught with a mobile phone in the exam hall?
answerable.expected_answer: treated as a first offence of unfair means: that paper cancelled, grade F

answerable.question: What time do the hostel gates close at night?
Can I use an induction cooktop in my hostel room?
How much is the late fee if I pay my semester fees after the due date?
answerable.expected_answer: Rs. 100 per day, capped at Rs. 1,500

answerable.question: What is the last date to pay the odd semester tuition fee?
answerable.expected_answer: due 15 July 2026; last date with late fee 31 July 2026

answerable.question: Who is eligible for the merit-cum-means scholarship?
answerable.expected_answer: family income up to Rs. 3,00,000 and CGPA at least 7.0

answerable.question: Do I get leave if there is a death in my family?
answerable.expected_answer: up to 7 days bereavement leave counted as attendance, for parent, sibling, grandparent or spouse

answerable.question: Will I get my hall ticket if I have not paid my tuition fees?
answerable.expected_answer: No; hall ticket withheld until dues are cleared

answerable.question: How long can a break of study be?
answerable.expected_answer: one semester or one academic year, medical grounds only, once

answerable.question: What is the maximum time allowed to complete the B.Tech programme?
Can I get a mess rebate if I go home for two weeks?
answerable.expected_answer: yes, for absences of 7 days or more recorded in advance

answerable.question: How much medical insurance cover do students have?
answerable.expected_answer: hospitalisation up to Rs. 1,00,000 per year

conflict.question: My attendance is 58% because I was hospitalised for three weeks. Can the shortage be condoned?
What is the lowest attendance percentage that can still be condoned on medical grounds?
If I withdraw my admission before classes begin, how much of my tuition fee will be refunded?
What CGPA do I need to maintain to keep my merit scholarship?

not_covered.question: What happens if I miss the end-semester exam because of a family wedding?
not_covered.adjacent: EE §3.1 covers absence due to illness only

not_covered.question: Can I get a re-test if I missed a mid-term test for a job interview?
not_covered.adjacent: EE §3.3 re-test is for medical grounds; LM §3.3 only marks attendance for placement interviews

not_covered.question: Can I change my branch after the first year?
not_covered.adjacent: nothing on branch change

not_covered.question: Is there a dress code for laboratory sessions?
not_covered.adjacent: nothing on dress code

not_covered.question: Can a day scholar eat in the hostel mess by paying per meal?
not_covered.adjacent: HH §4.1 covers residents only

not_covered.question: Are pets allowed in the hostel?
not_covered.adjacent: HH §5.4 lists prohibitions but not pets

not_covered.question: What is the fee for a duplicate identity card?
not_covered.adjacent: FS §1.1 fee table has no such line

not_covered.question: Can I get academic credit for a summer internship?
not_covered.adjacent: AR §2.4 course categories say nothing about internships

not_covered.question: Is there a scholarship for students from the EWS category?
not_covered.adjacent: SF §2 lists merit, merit-cum-means and sports only

not_covered.question: Are grace marks given if I fail a course by one or two marks?
not_covered.adjacent: AR §5.4 passing rule; EE §5.2 moderation is uniform, not individual grace

not_covered.question: Can I use a scientific calculator in the examination hall?
not_covered.adjacent: EE §2.1 and §2.2 list items but never mention calculators

not_covered.question: What happens if there is a printing error in the question paper?
not_covered.adjacent: nothing on question paper errors

not_covered.question: How do I get a duplicate degree certificate if I lose the original?
not_covered.adjacent: AR §12.3 covers issue of the original only

not_covered.question: How many books can I borrow from the library at a time?
not_covered.adjacent: library appears only in the no-dues clause AR §12.3

not_covered.question: What is the procedure to transfer to another university mid-course?
not_covered.adjacent: AR §12.3 mentions a transfer certificate but no transfer procedure

not_covered.question: Can I keep a two-wheeler in the hostel parking?
not_covered.adjacent: nothing on vehicles

not_covered.question: Is there a fee concession if my sibling also studies at the institute?
not_covered.adjacent: SF §6.1 covers wards of staff only

not_covered.question: Will I get my hall ticket if my hostel fee is unpaid but my tuition fee is paid?
not_covered.adjacent: AR §12.2 and EE §1.2 speak only of tuition fee dues

not_covered.question: What is the minimum CGPA to be eligible for campus placements?
not_covered.adjacent: LM §3.3 covers leave for interviews, not eligibility

not_covered.question: Can I re-appear in a course I have already passed to improve my grade?
not_covered.adjacent: AR §8.1 supplementary exams are for grade F only

not_covered.question: What happens if I fall ill in the middle of writing an exam?
not_covered.adjacent: EE §3.1 covers being unable to appear, not illness during the exam

not_covered.question: How do I get my name corrected on the grade card?
not_covered.adjacent: EE §6.2 covers clerical errors in results, not name corrections

not_covered.question: Can I audit a course without earning credits?
not_covered.adjacent: AR §3 registration rules say nothing about auditing

not_covered.question: Is the examination fee refunded if I withdraw from an exam?
not_covered.adjacent: FS §4.2 covers exam fee on withdrawal of admission, not from an exam

not_covered.question: What is the punishment for plagiarism in a project report?
not_covered.adjacent: EE §4 covers unfair means in examinations only
